top.title: Abu Dhabi property transactions reach Dhs171.26bn as sales double
top.impact_reason: Highlights surging sales values and strong market activity.
top.headline: Abu Dhabi Property Transactions Surge to AED 171.26 Billion
top.summary: Abu Dhabi recorded property transactions worth AED 171.26 billion as sales volumes doubled. This points to robust sector growth in the emirate.
top.why: It shows a massive surge in property transaction values and sales volume in Abu Dhabi.

top.summary: Total real estate transaction values in Abu Dhabi rose by 76.1 percent to reach AED 171.26 billion. The figures underscore rising investor interest in the emirate.
